column1: # Official NBA team statistics, 2026-27 regular season, per-game mode -- three pages, re-read
# 2026-11-16 by session arena/8f4fac33-nba3 with the Arena fetch tool.
#   read in 5 chunks (0-4); the Brooklyn row straddled the chunk 3/4 boundary and its OREB cell
#   ("11.6") arrived split as "11" + ".6" -- joined back and verified by the scoring identity.
#   read in 2 chunks (0-1); 30 rows complete inside the two chunks.
#   read in 2 chunks (0-1); the Dallas row straddled the boundary and was joined.
# NOTHING IS COMPUTED HERE -- every number is copied from the page. The refresh script then
# re-derives three identities that the pages must satisfy and refuses to publish a row that
#   traditional: PTS == 2*FGM + 3PM + FTM        REB == OREB + DREB      W + L == GP
#   opponent:    OppPTS == 2*OppFGM + Opp3PM + OppFTM   OppREB == OppOREB + OppDREB
#   advanced:    NetRtg == OffRtg - DefRtg       MIN == 48*GP + 5*(overtimes played)
# and a cross-page identity: traditional PTS - opponent OppPTS == traditional +/-.
# Per-game mode. A team with an overtime game has MIN/GP slightly above 48.0; the script reports
# the implied overtime count rather than pretending the pages agree exactly.
#META note = Every row was read on 2026-11-16 between 14:20Z and 14:35Z. The pages are per-game
#META note = mode for traditional and opponent, totals mode for advanced (MIN is season minutes
#META check = and POSS season possessions on the advanced page). MIN/GP above 48.0 implies
#META check = overtime; the refresh script reports the implied OT count per team.
